# Substrate

> Substrate turns your Markdown or Word documents into branded, SCORM- and
> cmi5-ready microlearning courses. Upload your content, generate, publish to
> any LMS.

Substrate converts source documents (Markdown or Word today) into
structured, sequenced microlearning courses with automatically-generated
knowledge checks, then packages them for any LMS or LRS that supports
SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004, or cmi5/xAPI, including Workday Learning,
Cornerstone, Docebo, and SCORM Cloud. Courses ship with automated WCAG
conformance checks (alt text, heading order, contrast). Pricing is one
flat-rate team subscription with unlimited authors, not per-seat.
